stories.title: Show HN: Kairos – Open-source risk and fraud decisioning platform
summary: Kairos addresses two of the biggest problems facing traditional decisioning tools: a lack of labeled data to train on and dealing with fraudsters that are constantly changing their tactics.1.
Traditional fraud solutions use ML models such as XGBoost to detect fraud, but these models are dependent on quality labeled data which many businesses do not have.
This also allows you to capture aspects of fraud that are more unstructured, which is something that XGBoost models struggle with.2.
